finding.expected: Keep the direct selector-only reusable handoff and minimum-sufficient permissions, but make the caller/callee permission chain valid without actions:write or new authority. Within TASK-280 scope, grant only the read permission actually required by the called workflow (including actions: read where required) or an equivalent least-privilege correction that does not modify local wake semantics. Add deterministic workflow-contract coverage for the permission ceiling so this cannot regress.
finding.issue: The new publisher direct handoff calls ./.github/workflows/aios-local-chat-wake.yml with the caller job limited to contents: read. The called reusable workflow contains jobs that request actions: read. GitHub reusable-workflow permissions may only be maintained or reduced across the call chain, not elevated. The repository's existing terminal-attention caller uses the same contents-only call shape and the current live RUN-280 terminal-attention carrier is observed as Startup failure, providing a concrete same-shape production counterexample. Therefore the candidate does not yet prove that an eligible publication event can enter the reusable local wake boundary from the publisher run.

original_constraints: The direct handoff must reuse the repository-owned brain_attention projector and the existing aios-local-chat-wake workflow_call/event_id contract; neither the publisher workflow nor YAML expressions may independently classify attention families or construct semantic next actions.

The existing workflow_run fan-in may remain as compatibility/fallback for producer paths where GitHub emits it. If both direct and workflow_run paths observe the same publication source, they must yield the same event_id so H4A4 persistent dedupe permits at most one user wake turn.

Publication success remains eligible only after exact PASS review lineage and exact reviewed-candidate inclusion in canonical main are proven by the existing publisher/projector. The wake carries selectors only and must never mark roadmap DONE, choose H4B, select an Executor/model, or claim planning completion.

AUTO_PUBLICATION_STARTED, dispatch acceptance and other ordinary progress remain non-wake. The direct bridge occurs only after bounded publication source projection; source/projection failure fails closed and must not fabricate an attention identity.

Keep GitHub permissions minimum-sufficient: no actions:write, no new secret, no token-bearing dispatch bridge. Calling the existing repository-local reusable wake workflow is a transport handoff, not new lifecycle authority.

Do not modify src/aios_renew/local_chat_wake.py or .github/workflows/aios-local-chat-wake.yml unless a deterministic proof shows the published workflow_call contract itself is insufficient; such a need would exceed this TASK's final modify scope and must fail closed for Human/Brain reconsideration.

Executor changes only the authorized files, updates the H4A5 conformance document to describe the repaired publication direct-handoff proof, and leaves live proof status unclaimed. Runtime owns canonical verification; Reviewer owns the semantic verdict; Publisher remains the only publication authority.
